# Ahmed Afridi

> > Professional portfolio of Ahmed Afridi: filmmaker, digital marketer, and AI tools curator with expertise in video production, SEO, and Asia's largest AI platform.

Ahmed Afridi is a filmmaker, documentary director, and COO at Din News Network, offering professional services in video production, digital marketing, and SEO optimization. He also curates Bank AI, Asia's largest AI tools directory featuring 50,700+ tools for content creation, productivity, and development.
